sources.title: The Stacks Project, Lemma 10.15.5
sources.used_statement: Part (1), and its adjugate construction, supply the exact matrix identity for a nonzero maximal minor.

sources.title: The Stacks Project, Lemma 10.20.1, Nakayama's lemma
sources.used_statement: Part (6) gives surjectivity of a finite module map over the local coefficient ring from surjectivity modulo its maximal ideal. This is an alternative to the direct determinant argument.

scope: Sourced finite coefficient-matrix route to characteristic zero; no properness of the inhomogeneous chart is asserted.
